```{=html}
<figure class="manual-figure" id="decoder" aria-labelledby="decoder-title">
  <h3 id="decoder-title">64bitの命令語を分解する</h3>
  <div class="controls js-only" hidden>
    <label>ISA <select id="decoder-isa"><option>mvp-0</option><option>mvp-1</option></select></label>
    <label>例 <select id="decoder-example"><option value="1100000000000000">LD r1, [0]</option><option value="0000000033120000">MUL r3, r1, r2</option><option value="2400800000000000">ST [1], r4</option><option value="00000000f0000000">HALT</option><option value="0000000045123000">MAC r5, r1, r2, r3</option><option value="0000000014310001">予約bit違反</option></select></label>
    <label>16進64bit <input id="decoder-hex" class="mono" type="text" value="1100000000000000" maxlength="16" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="decoder-input-help"></label>
  </div>
  <p id="decoder-input-help" class="figure-note">16桁を入力すると分解図を更新する。MACの例はmvp-1へ切り替えて読む。任意の命令列の合法性検査には独立verifierを使う。</p>
  <div class="bit-word"><strong>上位32bit — Memory word（bundle bits 63:32）</strong><div class="bit-strip" id="memory-fields"><div class="bit-field memory" style="--bits:4">31:28<strong>opcode = 1 / LD</strong></div><div class="bit-field memory" style="--bits:4">27:24<strong>reg = 1</strong></div><div class="bit-field memory" style="--bits:9">23:15<strong>addr = 0</strong></div><div class="bit-field reserved" style="--bits:15">14:0<strong>reserved = 0</strong></div></div></div>
  <div class="bit-word"><strong>下位32bit — Compute word（bundle bits 31:0）</strong><div class="bit-strip" id="compute-fields"><div class="bit-field" style="--bits:4">31:28<strong>opcode = 0 / NOP</strong></div><div class="bit-field reserved" style="--bits:28">27:0<strong>未使用 = 0</strong></div></div></div>
  <div class="decode-result" aria-live="polite"><p id="decoder-asm" class="mono">NOP | LD r1, [0]</p><p id="decoder-bytes" class="mono">.bin: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 11</p><p id="decoder-status">単一bundleのL1フィールド検査: 違反なし。</p></div>
  <figcaption class="figure-note">bit番号は各32bit word内の番号。幅の比率は説明用。フィールドはmachine descriptionのopcodeを使って分解する。L2〜L11はこの図では判定しない。</figcaption>
</figure>
```
